[head=2][color=#e8b04b]Custom Controls and Combat Basics[/color][/head]
This page covers the controls that differ from standard Space Station 14. For movement, inventory, interaction, and interface basics, start with [textlink="Controls" link="Controls"]. You can rebind anything here:
[head=3][color=#e8b04b]Melee Combat[/color][/head] Melee is its own system here, with wide swings, parries, ripostes, and executions. Turn on [bold]Combat Mode[/bold] from your action bar before you try to attack or parry.
- [color=#6ab7d6][keybind="Use"/][/color] is a committed swing that sweeps a wide arc and hits everyone in it. - [color=#6ab7d6][keybind="UseSecondary"/][/color] raises your guard to parry or block. - [color=#6ab7d6][keybind="MouseMiddle"/][/color] is a lighter single-target hit on a longer cooldown.
[textlink="Melee Combat" link="MeleeCombat"] explains what each one is actually for. Read it before you rely on a blade.
[head=3][color=#e8b04b]Looking Ahead / Peeking[/color][/head] Hold [color=#6ab7d6][keybind="LookUp"/][/color] and your camera slides toward the direction you are facing, letting you see [color=#e8b04b]further than normal[/color].
Use it to look around a corner or wall, spot a threat approaching from far away, or see your target before you shoot. If you want to check where you are aiming before firing, this key is a lifesaver.
[head=3][color=#e8b04b]Wielding and Racking Your Weapon[/color][/head] Two things trip up almost every new player here. Most rifles, shotguns, and heavy weapons [color=#d9776c]cannot be used properly one-handed[/color], and most firearms [color=#d9776c]do not chamber themselves automatically[/color] — even with a full magazine, the gun will not fire on an empty chamber.
Both use the same key. With the weapon in one hand and your other hand free, press [color=#6ab7d6][keybind="ActivateItemInHand"/][/color] to wield it, then press it again to rack a round into the chamber.
Keep in mind: - Rack the weapon once when you first pick it up. - After a magazine runs dry, load a fresh one and rack again. - Pump-action and manual weapons may need to be cycled after every shot. - Wielding improves accuracy a lot, and some weapons only fire while wielded.
To remove a chambered round, hold the weapon in one hand, make the other hand active and empty, then use [color=#6ab7d6][keybind="AltActivateItemInWorld"/][/color] on the weapon.
[head=3][color=#e8b04b]Lying Down and Taking Cover[/color][/head] [color=#6ab7d6][keybind="ToggleStanding"/][/color] makes you lie down or stand back up.
While lying down, press [color=#6ab7d6][keybind="ToggleCrawlingUnder"/][/color] to hide under or behind certain objects. This helps you take cover and stay out of sight.
Lying down also makes you a smaller target and lets you use low cover more effectively.
[head=3][color=#e8b04b]Action Slots[/color][/head] You can trigger abilities on the action bar with the number keys shown on their slots. By default, the top-row keys [color=#6ab7d6][keybind="Hotbar1"/][/color] through [color=#6ab7d6][keybind="Hotbar0"/][/color] activate the corresponding slots, which is much faster than clicking.
Drag and drop actions to arrange them. [color=#d9776c]Numpad 0 does not activate an action[/color]; it opens the Guidebook.
